name: Sales Booster GD for WooCommerce
author: Globaldev

sections.description:
Sales Booster GD for WooCommerce displays lightweight recent-purchase notifications using completed and processing WooCommerce orders from your own store.

The plugin runs locally on your WordPress installation. It does not send order data to Globaldev or another external service, and it does not collect visitor IP addresses or device fingerprints.

Main features

  • Display a random product from a recent completed or processing order.
  • Choose the order age window from 1 to 365 days.
  • Configure the first popup delay, interval and display duration.
  • Position notifications at the bottom left or bottom right.
  • Enable or disable notifications on mobile screens.
  • Show the customer’s first name, first initial or an anonymous label.
  • Optionally show billing city and country.
  • Optionally show the product image, relative purchase time and Globaldev credit.
  • Customize the accent, background and text colors.
  • Uses WooCommerce CRUD functions and supports High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Caches recent order IDs to reduce repeated database work.
  • No monthly visitor cap, expiry timer or external account is required.

Customer data notice

Depending on your settings, a notification can publicly display a customer’s first name or initial, billing city and country, purchased product and relative purchase time. Store owners are responsible for configuring the plugin in accordance with applicable privacy laws and their published privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sales-booster-gd-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP from Plugins > Add Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate WooCommerce.
  3. Activate Sales Booster GD for WooCommerce.
  4. Open Sales Booster GD in the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Configure the popup and save the settings.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin send customer or order information to an external server?

No. Eligible orders are read locally through WooCommerce and the popup is generated by your WordPress site.

Which orders can appear?

Orders with the Processing or Completed status created inside the configured order-age window can appear.

Can I hide customer details?

Yes. You can show a first name, first initial or anonymous label. City and country can also be disabled.

Does it support WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The plugin reads orders through WooCommerce CRUD APIs and declares HPOS compatibility.

Is there a traffic or visitor limit?

No. Version 1.1.0 removes the former visitor counter and traffic-based feature lock.
sections.changelog:
1.1.3

  • Corrected the plugin text domain to match the WordPress.org repository slug.
  • Updated every translatable string and the POT filename to use the correct text domain.
  • Removed obsolete manual translation loading; WordPress.org language packs load automatically.
  • Removed direct SQL and automatic schema deletion from update and uninstall routines.
  • Preserved removal of the former visitor-limit options and scheduled event.
  • Resolved the Plugin Check text-domain errors and database-query warnings shown for version 1.1.2.

1.1.2

  • Moved WordPress and third-party admin notices above the branded plugin header.
  • Added a dedicated screen-reader page title so notices inserted after the admin H1 cannot enter the hero panel.
  • Preserved the visual header design while improving admin-page semantics and compatibility.

1.1.1

  • Redesigned the frontend close control as a compact circular icon.
  • Added strong button resets so themes and page builders cannot stretch or restyle the close control.
  • Improved close-button hover, keyboard-focus and alignment behavior.
  • Updated the admin live preview to use the same icon treatment.

1.1.0

  • Removed the former monthly visitor counter, expiry reset and traffic-based feature lock.
  • Removed IP-address and browser/device fingerprint collection.
  • Removed promotional upgrade panels and external sales links.
  • Added a redesigned, responsive settings screen with live preview.
  • Added timing, placement, privacy, visibility and color settings.
  • Rebuilt frontend notifications with accessible markup and vanilla JavaScript.
  • Added nonce verification to the public AJAX request.
  • Improved performance by caching recent order IDs and limiting order queries.
  • Added WooCommerce dependency and HPOS compatibility declarations.
  • Updated compatibility metadata for modern WordPress, PHP and WooCommerce versions.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
